# Preparation and data load

```{r, include=FALSE}
library(randomForest)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(caret)
library(pROC)
```

```{r}
data <- read.csv("C:/Users/haoyu/Desktop/cleaned_data.csv")
head(data)
```

# 1. Rondom Forest


```{r}
data$Credit_Score <- as.factor(data$Credit_Score)

# Divide training and testing sets
set.seed(123)  
training_index <- sample(1:nrow(data), 0.8 * nrow(data))  # 选择80%数据为训练集
train_data <- data[training_index, ]
test_data <- data[-training_index, ]

# Establishing a random forest model
model <- randomForest(Credit_Score ~ ., data = train_data, ntree = 100)


#predictions <- predict(model, test_data)
#table(predictions, test_data$Credit_Score)


#accuracy <- sum(predictions == test_data$Credit_Score) / nrow(test_data)
#print(paste("Accuracy:", accuracy))

predictions <- predict(model, test_data)

# Using Confusion Matrix to Calculate Evaluation Metrics
conf_matrix <- confusionMatrix(as.factor(predictions), as.factor(test_data$Credit_Score))

print(conf_matrix)

accuracy <- conf_matrix$overall['Accuracy']
precision <- conf_matrix$byClass['Pos Pred Value']
recall <- conf_matrix$byClass['Sensitivity']
f1_score <- 2 * (precision * recall) / (precision + recall)

```


```{r}
print(table(data$Credit_Score))

print(table(predictions))

conf_matrix <- confusionMatrix(as.factor(predictions), as.factor(test_data$Credit_Score), mode = 'everything')
print(conf_matrix)

print(conf_matrix$byClass)

```



# 2. parameters


```{r}
library(ranger)

model <- ranger(
    Credit_Score ~ ., 
    data = data, 
    num.trees = 100, 
    mtry = floor(sqrt(ncol(data) - 1)),
    min.node.size = 10,
    num.threads = parallel::detectCores()  
)

print(model)


```


```{r}
mtry_values <- seq(2, 10, by = 2)
num_trees <- 100
oob_errors <- numeric(length(mtry_values))

# Train the model for each mtry value and collect OOB error rates
for (i in seq_along(mtry_values)) {
  model <- ranger(
    formula = Credit_Score ~ .,
    data = data,
    num.trees = num_trees,
    mtry = mtry_values[i],
    min.node.size = 10,
    num.threads = parallel::detectCores()
  )
  oob_errors[i] <- model$prediction.error
}


results <- data.frame(mtry = mtry_values, OOB_Error = oob_errors)

# Plot OOB error rate curve
ggplot(results, aes(x = mtry, y = OOB_Error)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "OOB Error Rate vs Mtry",
       x = "Number of variables randomly sampled as candidates at each split (mtry)",
       y = "OOB Error Rate") +
  theme_minimal()

```


```{r}
ntrees_values <- seq(100, 600, by = 100)
oob_errors <- numeric(length(ntrees_values))
mtry_values <- 4


# Collect OOB error rates
for (i in seq_along(ntrees_values)) {
  model <- ranger(
    formula = Credit_Score ~ .,
    data = data,
    num.trees = ntrees_values[i],
    mtry = floor(sqrt(ncol(data) - 1)),  
    min.node.size = 10,
    num.threads = parallel::detectCores()  
  )
  oob_errors[i] <- model$prediction.error
}



results <- data.frame(ntrees = ntrees_values, OOB_Error = oob_errors)

# Plot OOB error rate curve
ggplot(results, aes(x = ntrees, y = OOB_Error)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "OOB Error Rate vs Number of Trees",
       x = "Number of Trees",
       y = "OOB Error Rate") +
  theme_minimal()


```


# evaluation
```{r}
library(randomForest)
library(pROC)
library(caret)
library(ggplot2)

selected_features <- data[, c("Interest_Rate", "Credit_Mix", "Credit_History_Age", "Delay_from_due_date",
                              "Changed_Credit_Limit", "Amount_invested_monthly", "Monthly_Balance",
                              "Credit_Utilization_Ratio", "Total_EMI_per_month", "Num_Credit_Inquiries",
                              "Num_Credit_Card", "Annual_Income", "Monthly_Inhand_Salary", "Num_of_Delayed_Payment",
                              "Age", "Num_Bank_Accounts", "Payment_of_Min_Amount", "Credit_Score")]

selected_features$Credit_Score <- as.factor(selected_features$Credit_Score)

# Divide training and testing sets
set.seed(123)  
training_index <- sample(1:nrow(selected_features), 0.8 * nrow(selected_features))  
train_data <- selected_features[training_index, ]
test_data <- selected_features[-training_index, ]

# Establishing a random forest model
model <- randomForest(Credit_Score ~ ., data = train_data, ntree = 600, mtry = 6)


class_predictions <- predict(model, test_data)

prob_predictions <- predict(model, test_data, type = "prob")


print(table(data$Credit_Score))


print(table(class_predictions))
```






```{r}
# Calculate confusion matrix
conf_matrix <- confusionMatrix(as.factor(class_predictions), as.factor(test_data$Credit_Score), mode = 'everything')

# Accuracy
accuracy <- conf_matrix$overall['Accuracy']
print(paste("Accuracy:", round(accuracy, 3)))

stats <- conf_matrix$byClass[c("Precision", "Recall", "F1")]
class_levels <- levels(test_data$Credit_Score)  


# Precision, Recall, F1
precision <- conf_matrix$byClass[, "Precision"]
recall <- conf_matrix$byClass[, "Recall"]
f1_score <- conf_matrix$byClass[, "F1"]


class_levels <- gsub("Class: ", "", rownames(conf_matrix$byClass))

# Print relevant statistical data
for (i in 1:length(class_levels)) {
    cat("\n", class_levels[i], "Metrics:\n")
    cat("Precision:", round(precision[i], 3), "\n")
    cat("Recall:", round(recall[i], 3), "\n")
    cat("F1 Score:", round(f1_score[i], 3), "\n")
}

# Prepare ROC data
all_roc_data <- data.frame()
label_data <- data.frame()

class_levels <- levels(test_data$Credit_Score)
colors <- c("Good-Poor" = "black", "Good-Standard" = "red", "Poor-Standard" = "blue")
plot_titles <- names(colors)

for (i in 1:length(class_levels)) {
    actuals <- ifelse(test_data$Credit_Score == class_levels[i], 1, 0)
    preds <- prob_predictions[, class_levels[i]]
    roc_obj <- roc(actuals, preds)
    auc_value <- auc(roc_obj)  
    roc_data <- data.frame(
        specificity = 1 - roc_obj$specificities,
        sensitivity = roc_obj$sensitivities,
        class = plot_titles[i]
    )
    all_roc_data <- rbind(all_roc_data, roc_data)
    
    label_data <- rbind(label_data, data.frame(
        specificity = 0.2,  
        sensitivity = 1 - 0.05 * i,  
        class = plot_titles[i],
        label = paste("AUC for", class_levels[i], ":", round(auc_value, 3))
    ))
}

# Plot ROC curve graph
ggplot(all_roc_data, aes(x = specificity, y = sensitivity, color = class)) +
    geom_line() +
    scale_color_manual(values = colors, name = NULL) +  
    geom_text(data = label_data, aes(label = label), hjust = 0, vjust = 0) +
    labs(title = "Combined ROC Curve", x = "1 - Specificity", y = "Sensitivity") +
    theme_minimal()

```
